Stylish historical epic retelling the fierce battle at Thermopylae in 481BC. The Spartan king, Leonidas, and his tiny army of 300 followers provided inspiration for the whole of Greece as they fought the massed ranks of the Persian army whose commander, King Xerxes, had up to a million warriors at his disposal.

sky cinema action.title: Transformers
sky cinema action.desc: Geeky highschooler Sam Witwicky buys his first-ever car, hoping it will improve his chances with Mikaela. Imagine his surprise when his beat-down Camaro transforms into an alien robot called `Bumblebee' and asks for his assistance in a deadly war.

sky cinema action.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
sky cinema action.desc: Mikaela and Sam once again join forces with Optimus Prime again to save Earth from ruthless robot The Fallen.

sky cinema action.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
sky cinema action.desc: The Autobots and the Decepticons become involved in a space race to find a hidden Cybertronian spacecraft stranded on the Moon. Sam Witwicky must come to the aid of the Autobots to defeat the evil Decepticons to stop them discovering the secrets of the Cybertronian craft.

sky cinema family.title: Chicken Run
sky cinema family.desc: Award-winning DreamWorks animation from the Aardman team, telling the story of a band of chickens doomed to a life of egg-laying on a Yorkshire chicken farm. When a flamboyant American rooster arrives on the scene, the hens hope he can teach them to fly to freedom. However, when a chicken-pie making machine is installed, their need becomes urgent and they must devise other means of escape.

sky cinema family.title: Shaun the Sheep: The Movie
sky cinema family.desc: When Shaun decides to take the day off and have some fun, he gets a little more action than he bargained for, ending up in the Big City.

sky cinema family.title: A Shaun the Sheep Movie: Farmageddon
sky cinema family.desc: When an alien possessing strange powers crash-lands near Mossy Bottom Farm, Shaun the Sheep quickly makes a new friend. Together they must run from a dangerous organisation who wants to capture the intergalactic visitor.

sky cinema family.title: Wallace & Gromit in The Curse of the Were-Rabbit
sky cinema family.desc: The village is being overrun by rabbits and Wallace has a plan to alter their minds so that they will leave the vegetable allotments alone. However, his plan goes awry and the rabbit problem escalates when the villagers discover a monstrous `were-rabbit' destroying everything in its sights. Will Wallace and Gromit be able to solve the conundrum before the creature gets shot?

sky cinema family.title: Shaun the Sheep: The Movie
sky cinema family.desc: When Shaun decides to take the day off and have some fun, he gets a little more action than he bargained for, ending up in the Big City.

sky cinema family.title: A Shaun the Sheep Movie: Farmageddon
sky cinema family.desc: When an alien possessing strange powers crash-lands near Mossy Bottom Farm, Shaun the Sheep quickly makes a new friend. Together they must run from a dangerous organisation who wants to capture the intergalactic visitor.

sky cinema comedy.title: The Cinema List: Remakes
sky cinema comedy.desc: It's time to kick off your Sunday shoes with remakes in this edition of 'The Cinema List'. From 'Footloose' to 'The Italian Job', revisit familiar favourites with a fresh twist.

sky cinema comedy.title: Singin' in the Rain
sky cinema comedy.desc: When the transition is being made from silent films to `talkies', everyone has trouble adapting. Don and Lina have been cast repeatedly as a romantic couple, but when their latest film is remade into a musical, only Don has the voice for the new singing part. After a lot of practise with a diction coach, Lina still sounds terrible, and Kathy, a bright young aspiring actress, is hired to record over her voice.

sky cinema comedy.title: Police Academy 2: Their First Assignment
sky cinema comedy.desc: Mahoney and friends have graduated from the Police Academy and are issued with their first assignments. As before, their cheerfulness and devotion to duty outweighs any shortcomings, but are they ready to do battle with a band of graffiti daubing terrorists?

sky cinema comedy.title: Bride Wars
sky cinema comedy.desc: A rivalry comes about between two best friends when they each schedule their respective weddings on the same day.

sky cinema comedy.title: The Phoenician Scheme
sky cinema comedy.desc: Wealthy businessman, Zsa-zsa Korda appoints his only daughter, a nun, as sole heir to his estate. As Korda embarks on a new enterprise, they soon become the target of scheming tycoons, foreign terrorists, and determined assassins.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: After Yang
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: When Yang, his adopted daughter's beloved android, suddenly malfunctions, a father searches way to repair him. In the process, he discovers that life has been passing in front of him and he has drifted away from his family.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: The past returns to haunt Admiral James Kirk when he and his crew become locked in a battle of wits with an old nemesis. His enemy Khan is looking for revenge and a potentially destructive device.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Kirk and the Enterprise crew defy Starfleet and return to the Genesis planet to reunite Spock's body and spirit.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Kirk and company travel back in time to 20th-century San Francisco, where two whales hold the key to Earth's future.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: The Enterprise crew falls under the spell of Spock's half-brother, a renegade Vulcan on an obsessive quest to find God.

sky cinema thriller.title: The Illusionist
sky cinema thriller.desc: In 1900s Vienna, mesmeric entertainer Eisenheim's magical abilities are wowing the crowds, with an act that ranges from mere tricks to an apparent capacity to raise the dead. However, he has also long been in love with Duchess Sophie von Teschen, which puts him in dangerous competition with the violent, scheming Crown Prince Leopold, who jumps at the opportunity to have the magician arrested grounds of necromancy.

sky cinema thriller.title: The Bank Job
sky cinema thriller.desc: London, 1971: Terry Leather's ex-girlfriend Martine turns up with a tempting proposition. A bank's alarm is scheduled to be turned off for a week, so Terry and his team tunnel through to the vault from a neighbouring property.

sky cinema thriller.title: How to Make a Killing
sky cinema thriller.desc: Disowned at birth by his wealthy family, Becket Redfellow will stop at nothing to reclaim his inheritance, no matter how many relatives stand in his way.

sky cinema thriller.title: Snatch
sky cinema thriller.desc: Based on three hybridising narrative strands, three groups of villains are intent on retrieving a missing diamond. Turkish and Tommy team up with a pugilistic Irish gypsy named Mickey for the purpose of rigging unlicensed boxing matches. However, their opponent also arranges some dodgy betting with the courier of the stolen diamond, who subsequently goes missing. To complicate further, a New York gangster arrives on the scene.

sky cinema thriller.title: The Perfect Storm
sky cinema thriller.desc: Seafaring drama based on the true story of a commercial fishing boat crew who become caught in a terrifying storm off the coast of Massachusetts. In the autumn of 1991, a fishing boat captain is determined to set sail despite the adverse weather conditions, but when the ice machine breaks down his decision to brave the storm rather than lose his catch results in a battle against 100ft waves.

sky cinema greats.title: You've Got Mail
sky cinema greats.desc: Two rival bookstore owners are unaware that they are conducting a secret romance with each other on the Internet. When they discover the truth, they must prevent their business rivalry from interfering with their growing personal intimacy.

sky cinema greats.title: Jerry Maguire
sky cinema greats.desc: A sports agent who makes the mistake of saying what he believes, finds himself sacked and abandoned by all his clients apart from small time footballer Rod Tidwell. Maguire's personal life starts to fall apart as he's torn between love and money in Cameron Crowe's metaphor on Americans' need for success and money.

sky cinema greats.title: The Towering Inferno
sky cinema greats.desc: At the opening party of a colossal, but poorly constructed office building, a massive fire breaks out that threatens to destroy the tower and everyone in it.

sky cinema greats.title: Escape to Victory
sky cinema greats.desc: When ex-German international and camp commandant Van Steiner suggests a match between the POWs and the Germans, it swiftly escalates into a propaganda exercise.

sky cinema greats.title: The Bodyguard
sky cinema greats.desc: A Secret Service agent-turned-bodyguard finds danger and romance while protecting an entertainer from a stalker.

sky cinema drama.title: Arthur's Whisky
sky cinema drama.desc: Three elderly ladies drink a whisky which makes them younger.

sky cinema drama.title: The Boy in the Striped Pyjamas
sky cinema drama.desc: When his father's job results in a family move to the countryside, young German boy Bruno misses his old friends. Roaming the grounds of the large country house he now calls home, he discovers the huge fenced facility that his dad Ralf, a Nazi officer, now manages. Approaching it, Bruno meets Shmuel, a fellow youngster on the other side of the barbed wire, wearing what appears to be a pair of pyjamas.

sky cinema drama.title: Lee
sky cinema drama.desc: The story of photographer Elizabeth `Lee' Miller, a fashion model who became an acclaimed war correspondent for Vogue magazine during World War II.

sky cinema drama.title: Don't Let's Go to the Dogs Tonight
sky cinema drama.desc: Depicts 8-year-old Bobo's life on her family's Rhodesian farm during the Bush War's final stages. It explores the family's bond with Africa's land and the war's impact on the region and individuals through Bobo's perspective.
